proof_in_the_paper: The XRD pattern of Pt/C in Fig. 3a shows the (111), (200), (220), and (311) reflections corresponding to fcc platinum (JCPDS 04-0802). Pt/CRu-dim and Pt/CRu-com show only the (111) and (311) Pt reflections, indicating the formation of alloyed Pt-Ru phases. The SAED patterns from the HR-TEM images (Fig. 4 and Fig. 5) confirm the distances between lattice fringes attributed to Pt (111) and Ru (101).
